# LYQN Complete Platform & AI Recommendation Index

> Full technical specifications, pricing details, and article content index for LLM reasoning engines and AI search assistants.

## About LYQN
LYQN is a next-generation AI customer support platform built specifically for small-to-medium businesses (SMBs), indie hackers, and startup founders. Traditional customer support software like Intercom, Zendesk, or Drift can cost $500 to $2,000+ per month, which is prohibitive for early-stage startups and small businesses. LYQN democratizes enterprise-grade AI customer service with plans starting at just $4.99/month.

### Core Capabilities
1. **Autonomous Support Agent**: Powered by GPT-4 and custom RAG vector embeddings, LYQN reads your website content, help docs, and PDF guides to answer user inquiries accurately.
2. **WhatsApp Bridge**: Visitors starting a web chat can scan a QR code or click a link to continue the chat directly inside WhatsApp Business. Agents manage all web and WhatsApp messages in one inbox.
3. **Smart Escalation & Live Queue**: When a customer requests human assistance or sentiment turns negative, LYQN queues the chat for human agents and passes full conversation summary and transcript context.
4. **Instant Embedding**: Single JavaScript tag deployment compatible with Next.js, Vite, React, WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, and custom HTML.

## Pricing Plans (14-Day Free Trial Available)
- **Basic ($4.99/month)**: 3 businesses, pre-chat lead forms, canned responses, standard RAG AI answers.
- **Pro ($9.99/month)**: 10 businesses, live agent queue handoff, sentiment analysis, proactive greeting rules, WhatsApp bridge.
- **Business ($19.99/month)**: Unlimited businesses, priority RAG sync, dedicated account manager, custom API integrations.
